newsitem.title: USA: Market Hub unit gets EPA permit for storage.
newsitem.headline: Market Hub unit gets EPA permit for storage.

text.p: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency has given permission to a unit of Market Hub Partners LP to build and operate a gas storage project in Pennsylvania, the company said Monday.

Market Hub said the agency had given its subsidiary, NE Hub Partners LP, an area-wide permit for the Tioga Gas Storage Project in the north-central area of the state. Construction is expected to begin in the second quarter of the year, it added.
The company said the project would provide 10 billion cubic feet of gas storage capacity for the northeastern U.S. gas market.

The unit was negotiating contracts with potential Tioga customers even though it still had to get approval from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection, it said.
Market Hub is a Delaware limited partnership owned by TPC Gas Storage Services LP, an affiliate of TPC Corp and four other companies.
